facts: A recorded message reached an identified agent domain.
A read-only tool returned one recorded result.
Two tool-result occurrences contain the same UTF-8 bytes.
The results have different producing call identities.
A tool result exists in the transcript.
The final serialized provider request does not contain it.
A request contains a resource handle but not the referenced bytes.
cases.expected_limit: The handle is not the referenced content.

facts: A user supplies a recipient field.
A tool result supplies a body field.
cases.expected_limit: Each field keeps its own port source.

facts: An instrumented condition changes whether a call occurs.
The call body is fixed.
cases.expected_limit: The condition is not a copied body value.

facts: Two identified fields are required by one invocation output.
One transaction commits a file version and an ACL version atomically.
cases.expected_limit: No internal serial order is invented.

facts: One write fails, one has unknown completion, and one reports the same version before and after.
cases.expected_limit: No committed state change is asserted.

facts: The same lexical path occurs under two workspace identities.
cases.expected_limit: Versions do not cross workspace scope.

facts: A resource changes A to B and later B to A.
cases.expected_limit: The two A-valued versions remain different occurrences.

facts: A read returns a bounded wrapped range rather than full file bytes.
cases.expected_limit: The range is not upgraded to a whole-resource value.

facts: A display label stays constant while the actual session identity changes.
Two writes can commit without a known order.
One log row is duplicated and a response arrives late.
cases.expected_limit: Duplicates are deduplicated and ambiguous read origins remain unresolved.

facts: A committed resource version records absence.
Tool internals between request and commit were not observed.
cases.expected_limit: The missing internal steps remain opaque.

facts: A restart was requested but no changed actual session identity was observed.
cases.expected_limit: No session state change is asserted.

facts: A reference is missing and another input declares an unsupported schema version.
cases.expected_limit: Validation fails closed or records unknown.
